<mxfile host="make-drawio-svg" type="device"><diagram id="page-1" name="Review source and controls before loading executable components"><mxGraphModel dx="800" dy="600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="325" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="review" value="REVIEW
Source + publisher" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2ff;strokeColor=#6b96cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="70" width="235" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="revision" value="PIN
Reviewed revision" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1ebfb;strokeColor=#9b7ac3;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="295" y="70" width="235" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="controls" value="CHECK
Trust + permissions" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff3db;strokeColor=#c59b4f;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=25;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="570" y="70" width="235" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="load" value="LOAD
Approved package" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e6f4ec;strokeColor=#68a485;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="845" y="70" width="235" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="caption" value="Installation may enable executable components.
Review host controls before that boundary, not afterward." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="230" width="1060" height="75" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e1" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="review" target="revision"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e2" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="revision" target="controls"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e3" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="controls" target="load"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.title: Review source and controls before loading executable components
svg.desc: Review source and publisher, select a reviewed revision, and check host trust, permissions, and sandbox controls before installing or loading the approved package. Package-path containment is not a subprocess sandbox; installation itself may enable executable components.

text.tspan: Review host controls before that boundary, not afterward.
